name: Site-First SEO
author: POTAR

sections.description:
Site-First SEO is a powerful alternative to traditional SEO plugins. Instead of relying on third-party APIs, Site-First focuses on on-site SEO, content quality, and user experience—the factors you control directly.

Whether you’re managing a personal blog, a small business site, or an enterprise WordPress installation, Site-First SEO helps you analyze, optimize, and improve:

  • Content Quality Audit: See how readable, keyword-rich, and optimized your content is.
  • GEO SEO Insights: Get localized keyword checks and geo-targeted optimization suggestions.
  • Internal Links Analysis: Identify orphan pages, strengthen site structure, and boost crawl depth.
  • Image Alt Audit & Link Checker: Catch missing alt tags, broken links, and SEO-killing errors.
  • Redirect Manager & 404 Monitor: Create smart redirects, fix broken traffic paths, and reclaim SEO value.
  • Visits Tracking Module: Simple, privacy-friendly site analytics right inside your WordPress dashboard.
  • Sitemap Generator: Automatic, SEO-friendly XML sitemaps—no bloat.

Unlike Yoast, Rank Math, or All-in-One SEO, Site-First SEO was built for practical on-site optimization, not endless upsells. The free version covers the essentials; the PRO version unlocks advanced redirect intelligence, GEO reporting, and content scoring.

Why Site-First SEO?

  • API-less: No Google API keys needed—works out of the box.
  • Lightweight: Minimal database overhead; built for speed.
  • Transparent: No hidden upgrades or nagging notifications.
  • Built for Professionals: Used by developers, SEOs, and agencies managing multiple client sites.

Who is it for?

  • Website owners wanting SEO basics without bloat
  • Agencies and freelancers looking for client-friendly SEO reporting
  • Businesses needing GEO SEO insights for local rankings
  • WordPress users who care about content quality and on-site improvements
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/site-first-seo, or install via the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu.
  3. Access Site-First SEO from your WordPress Dashboard.
sections.faq:
Does Site-First SEO replace Yoast or Rank Math?

Yes, in most cases. Site-First SEO includes on-site content audits, internal links, redirects, and sitemaps—the same features you’d use in Yoast or Rank Math, but lighter and without third-party bloat.

Do I need API keys?

No. Site-First SEO was built to work without external APIs. You don’t need Google accounts, API keys, or subscriptions.

Is there a PRO version?

Yes. Site-First SEO PRO adds advanced redirect intelligence, BOT Block, GEO reporting, extended content scoring, and more professional-grade reporting tools.

Will it slow down my site?

No. Site-First SEO is designed for lightweight performance, using efficient scans and database calls.
